versions.changelog: Expanded OBSERVE framework, calibration bias checklist, delivery conversation scripts, legal compliance section

- Initial release of the Performance Review Writer skill.
- Instantly generates structured, fair, and actionable performance reviews from raw employee notes.
- Supports custom rating scales and references to company values.
- Output includes summary, strengths, growth areas, SMART goals, and rating with rationale.
- Helpful usage examples, tips, and integration with AfrexAI business tools provided.
